notes.title: v1.11.0 – A New Cottage Arrives!
notes.notes: [p][b]Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the 3rd selectable cottage: Circus Cottage.[/p][/*][*][p]New Spirit: Wise Elder.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where monsters spawned at incorrect positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Repair Spirit could not increase the durability of certain skill cards.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.10.8 - Coins are now capped at 999,999,999
notes.notes:
Coins are now capped at 999,999,999.
Fixed an issue where the upgraded "Purification Potion" gave the wrong amount of coins.

notes.title: v1.10.7 - Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Optimized the tutorial text content.
Fix an issue where skill damage could cause an error.

notes.title: v1.10.6 - The coin drop from Stone Giant has been increased by 1.
notes.notes:
The coin drop from Stone Giant has been increased by 1.
The target coin amount for Years 19 and 24 has been increased by 2.
Fixed an issue where some texts were displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: v1.10.5 – 5 New Spirits Added!
notes.notes:
Added 5 new spirits.
Updated the upgraded effect of the skill card "Bomb".
Adjusted the value requirement of the skill card "Clown Mask".
Spirit rewards can now be skipped.
Skill cards that apply curses can now activate without an empty slot if their durability is 1.
Fixed a bug where Ebon Dragon could silence other monsters.

notes.title: v1.10.4
notes.notes: Refined text descriptions for card upgrade mechanics.

notes.title: 1.10.3：Resolved a bug that may impact the next game after finishing Endless Mode
notes.notes: Resolved a bug that may impact the next game after finishing Endless Mode.

notes.title: Made Endless Mode easier to unlock.
notes.notes: Endless Mode is now unlocked by winning with any cottage at Ascension Level 2.
